data.why: The repo's only bundled example data (test data/*_CSV and *_Compressed images) are raw ImageJ coordinate CSVs plus pre-segmentation TIFs; the app's own 'Process' step needs those paired with an alpha-channel worm-silhouette PNG mask produced by the separate GPU-only SAM-Plus app (not runnable here), so no repo file can drive that tab. The other four analysis tabs instead consume an already-pivoted 'relative distances' CSV (one row per worm, one column per named neuron, values = % position along the AP axis, SABVL=0/Rectum=100 as fixed poles) which the repo never ships as a standalone example, so two such files were synthesized, matching the exact column set and order the code produces (filename, SABVL, SABVR, SABD, DA1-DA9, Rectum, DD1-DD6, DB1-DB7), with realistic worm-to-worm jitter, one missing neuron value (WT-05, DD4) and one outlier mispositioned neuron (sax-3-03, DA5) to exercise error handling.

goals: Compare normalized antero-posterior positions of SAB/DA/DD/DB motoneurons between a wild-type control cohort and a VNC-patterning mutant (sax-3) using the Arrow plot with significance markers and effect sizes
Visualize the full distribution of each neuron's relative position per genotype with a combined violin and box plot to spot shifts or increased variance
Check whether neuron position measurements are normally distributed per genotype with QQ plots and Shapiro-Wilk tests before relying on parametric statistics
Rank each individual worm's neurons by antero-posterior order to detect animals with out-of-sequence (mispositioned) neurons
Export the Shapiro-Wilk normality table and the combined relative-distance results for downstream reporting

review.summary: The goal is right and every node is supported by its screens, but the tree covers only the arrow comparison and a half-working rank-order view. Normalisation, distribution plots, normality testing and exports are all missing. Most of that was lost to a matplotlib version mismatch that can be fixed, so pin matplotlib, rerun the broken tabs, and restructure the phases before filing.
